parts.name: DCSSR complete native controller shell with integral button tongue

notes: Component 0 is the complete assembled native controller shell (2654 triangles = displaced components 1+2). One rigid -90 degree Z rotation and translation; no scaling/cuts/fills. This exact U140 path resolves to the same source blob as the U139 controller shell. The U140 drawing 45 x 30.7 x 11.5 mm includes the external fork lugs, while the closed shell alone is 44.94 x 18.74 x 11.5 mm. Full DC SSR case/guards/installed transform are reconstructed from U140 photographs; the approximately 45 x 80 x 31 mm kit envelope is an appearance estimate, not an official U140 dimension. Original integral tongue flexes only during external button actuation; rest vertices/normals restored exactly.
